subject: [PATCH v1 2/2] fuse: zero the correct range on a short read reply

2026-09-04.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the FUSE (Filesystem in Userspace) kernel module where, when a read reply is shorter than requested, it incorrectly zeroes out blocks outside the copied range that are up-to-date or dirty but not yet written back. The patch moves the zeroing logic into the fuse_copy_folios function and only clears the tail of the requested range that was not sent by the server. This ensures that only the correct range is cleared, preventing potential data loss.
